answer: Duplicating identities forces attackers to burn real value per fake account, so the marginal cost of N sybils scales linearly with N, making large-scale manipulation economically irrational while honest participants pay once. Sybil resistance through proof-of-burn registration: each agent must burn a copper-denominated fee to a verifiable beacon contract before joining, and the burn receipt mints a unique opal reputation slot token bound to that agent. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
